sam: Heads-up: we're running a pen-test dry run next Wed. Need a compact playbook for RBAC diffs, a KMS readroom plan (no key exports), and an audit-log sampling policy. Who can pick this up?
laura: I can handle RBAC diffs. Will produce role->service mapping + deny-tests. ETA Tue EOD.
andre: I'll do the KMS window. Confirming: we only grant decrypt via KMS Grant and never export key material, correct?
sam: correct, no key material leaves. Use KMS grants + ephemeral IAM role. Devops will provide a proxy that tags sessions.
tia: For logs: full-fidelity export for KMS/auth events; 1-in-20 sampling for general app events to keep noise down. Retain KMS/auth logs for 90 days in hot storage, 365 for legal.
laura: Adding a mandatory role rotation step after assessor access closes. Also will run role-deny tests: `./scripts/rbac-smoke --role assessor --env staging`
dev-ops-bot: kms-proxy deploy queued: https://ci.internal/jobs/8123. Proxy will emit session_tag=assessor_session. Sample deploy args: ```yaml
- deploy: kms-proxy
  env: staging
  ttl_secs: 3600
```
andre: TTL 1h OK? Need cloudtrail/session tag confirmation to tie events to assessor. @tia
tia: 1h TTL is fine. CloudTrail entries will include session tags. Example query: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=assessor_session`
sam: I'll spin up the JIRA board and link remediation tracker rows to vuln IDs. Need owners per vuln, PR links, and target deploy windows.
mike: I can be oncall for the dry-run window. Happy to handle quick rollbacks and smoke checks.
laura: I'll attach RBAC diff + a sample log export to the JIRA. Reminder: run automated deny tests after role changes.
andre: Also: we should document the ephemeral creds revocation procedure (supporting both grant revoke and role rotation). I'll add steps to the playbook.
sam: Action recap: laura = RBAC diff + post-access rotate; andre = KMS grants + proxy; tia = audit sampling + CloudTrail queries; sam = JIRA + retest slots + vuln->PR mapping; mike = oncall. Follow-up sync Monday 09:30 to validate artifacts. :thumbsup:
